chaitriPunam.navpadOliDesc: A 9-day austerity cycle concluding on Chaitra Purnima (Day 9 — Samyag Tap).
chaitriPunam.ashtaprakariDesc: Eight substances offered in worship, each symbolising an inner spiritual principle.
chaitriPunam.kayotsargaDesc: Track your Kayotsarga (body-abandonment) repetitions. Advanced Chaitra observance: 150 repetitions.
